lessons.failure: File hash matches a user-supplied digest
lessons.rule: Never promote a matching hash to independently authenticated provenance.

lessons.failure: Archive contains files named analysis_complete or result
lessons.rule: Filename/metadata is not proof of an actual completed analysis or numeric result.
A claim cannot self-certify its own signature, independent trust or engineering acceptance.

lessons.failure: Traversal or symlink in evidence path
lessons.rule: Reject rather than follow references outside the bounded evidence root.

lessons.failure: Duplicate JSON keys or case-insensitive duplicate filenames
Missing file coexists with matching files
lessons.rule: Mark gate incomplete and stop; do not silently treat partial evidence as complete.

lessons.failure: ZIP has extreme compression ratio or invalid metadata
lessons.rule: Reject without extraction; never execute packaged code.

lessons.failure: Sensitive HTTP bytes included in evidence
lessons.rule: Hash locally only and emit codes/counts, not payloads, IDs or paths.

lessons.failure: HTTP 200 with empty message is treated as numerical output
lessons.rule: Require actual HEAD/DATA numeric rows plus authenticated E1-E6 before any E7 review.
Offline inventory is not a secure filesystem boundary; production integration requires hardened directory-handle based reads and external attestation.
